response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer (15+ years) but shows essentially no overlap with the core requirements of a Principal Performance Architect for AI accelerators. There is no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, RTL or architectural simulation, hardware-software co-design, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or deep neural network training/inference optimization. The closest adjacencies are low-latency service work in D at Sociomantic, some C/C++ at National Instruments, and hobby-level embedded/audio projects — none of which approach principal-level silicon performance architecture. Education is a BS in CS with sufficient years of experience to meet the formal bar, but the domain experience gap is disqualifying for this role.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering across web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded work
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/s at Sociomantic) plus C/C++ experience
Strong community engagement: open-source projects, conference talks, and technical workshops
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No AI/deep-learning workload, GPU, or SIMD/MIMD accelerator background
Career trajectory is application/web full-stack, not silicon performance architecture at principal level

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / DNN workload optimization background
Extensive general software engineering and systems performance experience
